title: HMA Agro Industries Ltd - 543929 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue INR 2,072 crore (~90% YoY) and PAT INR 31.9 crore, but no capacity, utilisation or pricing disclosure; growth attributed to buffalo meat exports with unexplained other income surge.

summary.headline: HMA Agro Q1 FY27 standalone revenue rose about 90% YoY to INR 2,072.14 crore, with standalone PAT of INR 31.91 crore versus INR 7.17 crore.
summary.overview: Management reported strong Q1 FY27 growth in revenue, EBITDA, PBT and PAT on a YoY basis, with margins improving on a stated operating-leverage basis. Consolidated revenue was INR 2,110.32 crore and consolidated PAT was INR 50.51 crore. Management attributed other income mainly to forex gains, duty drawback and fixed-deposit interest, and said buffalo meat exports remain the core business. Q&A was thin: only two individual investors asked questions, and several answers were deferred to a later follow-up.

segments.name: Buffalo meat (export)
segments.commentary: Management described buffalo product exports as the biggest part of revenue from operations and the core business driving growth. No volume or value split was given.

segments.name: Value-added / pet food
segments.commentary: Management said value-added products are not yet showing good market response and that pet food is at a very early stage; no revenue contribution was disclosed.

guidance_outlook: No explicit numerical guidance for FY27 revenue, margin or capex was given.
Management said the focus is on sustaining growth and momentum, improving operational efficiency, strengthening market presence and optimising profitability.
Pet food was described as a growing global market where the company is building a separate product-development research team, with no timeline or financial figures.
capex_capacity: No capacity, utilisation, capex plans or commissioning timelines were discussed on the call.
Management referred only to a separate research team for pet food product development; no capex or plant commissioning was mentioned.
Q&A did not cover plant capacity or utilisation; the Vietnam and Brazilian beef questions raised by an investor were not answered.
demand_pricing: Management attributed revenue growth to buffalo meat export volumes but gave no volume, price or realisation breakup.
Management said the value-added product line is not yet gaining traction in the market, with the core focus on buffalo meat.
Pet food demand was described as good and growing globally, with by-products of the buffalo business used in pet food.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the sharp rise in other income, and what is its breakup?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said other income comprises forex gain, duty drawback and interest on fixed deposits with banks. No figures were given; a separate follow-up was promised to the investor.

qa_highlights.question: Can you break down the ~88% QoQ revenue growth into value and volume?
qa_highlights.answer: Not answered on the call. Management said the team would follow up separately with the investor. (The transcript describes the comparison as YoY in the prepared remarks and QoQ in the question.)

qa_highlights.question: Does HMA sell certificates from its plants to other exporters, recorded in other income?
qa_highlights.answer: Not directly answered on the call; the other-income explanation given (forex, duty drawback, FD interest) does not mention certificate sales.

qa_highlights.question: Does HMA have a subsidiary or business in Vietnam, and is Brazilian beef included under HMA?
qa_highlights.answer: Not answered on the call. Management moved on and promised a follow-up.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the margin improvement and what share do value-added products contribute? What is the outlook for value-added products and pet food?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said value-added products are not yet getting a good market response and the core focus remains buffalo meat. Pet food is a growing global market, but the company is at a very early stage and could not give a financial outlook. No contribution figure was given.

risks_watch: Other income rose sharply and is partly forex-driven, so PBT and PAT may be flattered by non-operating items; the breakup was not provided on the call.
Heavy dependence on buffalo meat exports; value-added and pet food lines are early-stage and unproven.

Revenue and margins are reported with inconsistent and sometimes contradictory figures in the prepared remarks (for example, YoY vs QoQ comparison bases and margin ranges), which need verification against the filed results.
Open investor questions on Vietnam operations, Brazilian beef business and certificate sales were not resolved on the call.
Q&A was limited to two individual investors and was cut short; no institutional analyst questions were taken.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the headline growth and margin expansion, but vague and deferential on specifics. Management gave no breakups for other income, revenue volume or value, or value-added contribution, and deferred several answers to later follow-ups.
key_quotes: Overall, the first quarter of FY2026-27 has been a quarter of strong top-line growth, significant operating leverage, and substantial improvement in the profitability.
This is our main core business, which is helping us to create this growth, this momentum, and this revenue.
As of now, the value addition in the main product is not showing a good response to the market.
